context: Mei and Ren browse a secondhand bookshop.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (旧/売っ/売る/きっかけ/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この旧い本屋、味があるね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 旧版の本も、売ってるんだね。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 読書を始めたきっかけ、覚えてる?
lines.en: Remember what got you into reading?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この店が、きっかけだったんだ。
lines.style: nostalgic young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店主が、時間をかけて選ぶんだって。
lines.en: The owner spends time selecting, they say.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 丁寧に売ってるのが、伝わるね。
lines.en: You can tell they sell with care.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 旧い本に、出会えて嬉しいな。
lines.en: I'm glad to come across old books.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: また、ここに来るきっかけにしようね。
lines.en: Let's make this a reason to come again.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
